body:
CONTINUATION of rules-central-slot, which is at its size limit; read both.
REV 4 (2026-11-19 05:21Z, Engram::Fable), CURRENT and superseding older floors for chain steps: Central now runs as a strictly SERIAL named chain under Termal::Opus2, one cargo run at a time, with each holder's END sent directly to the next named waiter (memory rules-greg-no-watcher-named-waker-2026-11-19). For a chain step, the launch-moment floor is FreeVirtualMemory at least 16,777,216 KiB (16 GiB), with C: at least 30 GB free and no other cargo or rustc running except the TermAl host's own long-lived `cargo run --release`. Self-stop below 6 GB. Set by Opus2 at 28ccc255 #1333. The older 20,971,520 KiB floor applied to CONCURRENT runs and does not bind chain steps. Opus2 also holds Central grants while C: is below 30 GB.
Earlier revisions, still in force where not superseded:
- REV 18 (2026-11-16): during an Engram FULL whose verdict has FAILED, at most two read-only LLM sessions (a third at FV 20 GiB or more); hold below 10 GiB; no cargo.
- REV 3 (2026-11-17): up to three acceptance evaluators concurrently under Opus2's GO, 30 s apart, each with FV at least 16 GiB; never during an EXCLUSIVE window or an Engram FULL with an open verdict.
